name: Power Pro Kun Pocket 4
original_name: パワプロクンポケット4
source:
Main character moves to Hinode Island and accidentally breaks island's memorial on the way. He enrolls in school baseball club which is very poorly organized and is prone to constant failures. Then local priest tells protagonist that club's misadventures are results of the broken island memorial curse. In order to break the curse the team must achieve national level.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
